tickets.summary: K-3401 NDE bearing vibration increased from 2.1 to 4.6 mm/s in six weeks with growing 1x and sidebands; trend remains upward on the single-train export compressor.
tickets.recommended_action: Rotating equipment specialist to inspect NDE bearing vibration trend and diagnose 1x/sideband cause; repair per findings. Check deviation register/status

likelihood_of_failure.rationale: Active upward vibration trend with developing spectral features indicates meaningful degradation and potential progression toward bearing or rotor-related failure, although the compressor remains below alarm and functional.

impact_of_failure.rationale: Failure of the single export compressor train would rapidly cut production with no available redundancy or workaround, creating severe operational consequences.

tickets.summary: FW-8102 failed first-start demand during weekly test and only started after 8 s cranking with low 22.8 V batteries, degrading firewater availability while FW-8101 also has reduced discharge pressure.
tickets.recommended_action: Inspect/charge batteries and diagnose start system faults; repeat auto/manual start test at rated conditions Check impairment/deviation log Measure FW-8101 flow and pressure

likelihood_of_failure.rationale: A demanded start already failed once during testing, low battery voltage was measured, and the equipment has a recurring history of start issues. The function was recovered on the second attempt, so complete failure is not yet confirmed.

impact_of_failure.rationale: Loss of FW-8102 would materially degrade fire protection. A second pump exists, but another finding shows reduced performance on FW-8101, so redundancy cannot be fully credited.

tickets.summary: PL-1002 flowline wall thickness at low-point drain measured 6.2 mm against 7.4 mm minimum allowable with wet insulation and heavy scaling, confirming active CUI and loss of required wall-thickness margin.
tickets.recommended_action: Assess and isolate or repair corroded low-point drain section; inspect CUI extent and restore wall above minimum allowable. Verify deviation status

likelihood_of_failure.rationale: Required pressure-boundary function is confirmed failed because measured wall thickness is below the stated minimum allowable and active CUI conditions are present.

impact_of_failure.rationale: Failure of this non-redundant live hydrocarbon flowline at full wellhead pressure could cause a major hydrocarbon release with severe operational and personnel consequences.

tickets.summary: One FG-0455 detector head in the compression module 2oo3 gas detection group failed repeated 50% LEL bump tests with two cylinders, degrading but not defeating voted gas detection capability.
tickets.recommended_action: Inspect and repair/replace failed detector head; calibrate and bump test channel; Verify impairment logged

likelihood_of_failure.rationale: The detector head has confirmed inability to respond during repeated functional testing, so the channel's required function is failed.

impact_of_failure.rationale: Loss of one detector head degrades hydrocarbon gas detection in the compression module, but the remaining two channels in the 2oo3 arrangement still provide voted detection capability.

tickets.summary: CR-5001 main hoist rope has 6 broken wires per lay length at maximum boom radius with poor lubrication, below the 10-wire discard limit but showing active degradation on the crane's only lifting line.
tickets.recommended_action: Inspect and relubricate hoist rope section, assess broken-wire progression against lifting standard, replace rope if limits exceeded.

likelihood_of_failure.rationale: The rope shows active degradation and poor lubrication, but remains below discard criteria and the crane function is still available. Progression toward loss of lifting capability is credible but not near-certain.

impact_of_failure.rationale: Failure of the main deck crane would stop supply boat offloads and logistics support, with no redundant crane available. Consequences are operationally significant but not evidenced as major-accident protection loss.

urgency.rationale: triage-policy-v1: ceil(0.7*I+0.3*L), L=5, I=6, base=6, final=6.

tickets.summary: Corrosion inhibitor pump P-3305 has tripped three times this month and injection has been intermittent for about 10 days, confirming loss of continuous inhibitor delivery to the wellhead manifold.
tickets.recommended_action: Inspect diaphragm and discharge system, repair as found, restore stable inhibitor injection. Check inhibitor impairment record

likelihood_of_failure.rationale: The pump has repeated low-pressure trips this month and confirmed intermittent injection over ten days. The component is currently unable to provide continuous required service, meeting the confirmed function failure criterion.

impact_of_failure.rationale: Loss of corrosion inhibitor injection can initiate progressive internal corrosion in downstream hydrocarbon piping with no redundant pump available. Consequences are delayed rather than immediate, but can become material integrity threats.

tickets.summary: Widespread coating breakdown and rust staining on cellar deck plating between grids C2-C5 remain on backlog; no evidence of section loss or cracking, but continued exposure can promote future structural degradation.
tickets.recommended_action: Inspect deck plating for corrosion/section loss beneath failed coating; repair coating system where required. UT inspect plating beneath coating

likelihood_of_failure.rationale: The finding shows persistent atmospheric coating degradation over a broad area, but no measured section loss, cracking, or active structural impairment. Existing backlog status and historical cosmetic nature support a low-to-moderate near-term likelihood of required structural function loss.

impact_of_failure.rationale: If the degraded coating eventually led to structural deterioration, the affected steelwork is part of primary support structure with no stated redundancy. Current evidence indicates cosmetic coating degradation only, without confirmed section loss or cracking, so impact remains moderate.

tickets.summary: Temporary refuge pressurisation test on HVAC-7201 achieved 27 Pa against a 50 Pa minimum, confirming failed refuge overpressure protection with no evidenced redundancy.
tickets.recommended_action: Inspect TR dampers, seals and leakage paths; repair as found and repeat pressurisation test to verify >=50 Pa. Verify impairment/deviation status

likelihood_of_failure.rationale: The required refuge pressurisation function has already failed its acceptance criterion during testing, confirming inability to perform the required function.

impact_of_failure.rationale: Loss of temporary refuge pressurisation during a gas release could expose personnel in the refuge to hydrocarbons, and no redundant pressurisation unit is evidenced.

tickets.summary: PSV-3420 certification tag is illegible from corrosion, but records show March 2025 recertification and no evidence of relief-function degradation on the compressor discharge PSV.
tickets.recommended_action: Replace corroded PSV certification tag and confirm asset register identification remains traceable.

likelihood_of_failure.rationale: Only the external certification label is degraded. The valve remains in certification with no evidence of leakage, failed testing or functional degradation, so there is little supported indication of near-term required-function loss.

impact_of_failure.rationale: If this PSV were to fail its required overpressure protection function, consequences could be severe because it protects the compressor discharge with no stated redundancy. However, the present finding is only a tag legibility issue with no evidence of degraded relief capability.

tickets.summary: FW-8101 delivered only 9.2 barg versus 11 barg design during weekly test; reduced firewater performance may indicate pump wear or test-line restriction, with companion pump also showing recent start issues.
tickets.recommended_action: Inspect test line/valves and pump internals; restore rated firewater duty. Flow and pressure test Verify impairment logged Check impairment status Retest FW-8102 availability

likelihood_of_failure.rationale: The pump demonstrated degraded performance during a functional test, indicating an active issue affecting firewater delivery. However, the pump still started and ran, and the root cause may be test-line related rather than confirmed pump degradation, so complete required-function failure is not yet confirmed.

impact_of_failure.rationale: Failure of this duty firewater pump would materially degrade a major accident protection system. A second pump exists, but the companion pump has its own recent start impairment, reducing confidence in available redundancy.

tickets.summary: Second-stage discharge line lagging on K-3401 is loose and flapping in wind; no process impact reported but continued deterioration could create a dropped-object hazard.
tickets.recommended_action: Secure/remove loose discharge-line lagging and inspect cladding supports for damage or missing fixings. Check anomaly/deviation log

likelihood_of_failure.rationale: The cladding attachment has already degraded and is actively moving in service, making further detachment credible in the near term, but the assessed function is limited to lagging retention rather than compressor operation.

impact_of_failure.rationale: If the loose lagging condition worsens, the credible consequence is a localized dropped-object or housekeeping issue rather than loss of compressor process function or a major accident protection layer.
